topic.title: Can a CatBoost-based approach be competitive in this competition?
topic.author: Maxim Stepanov

raw.title: Can a CatBoost-based approach be competitive in this competition?
Can a CatBoost-based approach be competitive in this competition?

firstMessage.content:
My best public score is 0.673 with a transformer ensemble, but inference takes around 6 hours. I also tried a lighter CatBoost, LightGBM, XGBoost and TF-IDF stack, which scored 0.336.

Do you think a lightweight CatBoost-based approach, perhaps with external data or text embeddings, could realistically reach the top 20? Now I’m wondering: could a CatBoost-based solution realistically reach the top 20 in this competition?

I’m considering adding external training data, text embeddings and maybe AutoGluon for stacking. Has anyone managed to get a strong score with CatBoost as a major part of their solution?

Or should I accept that the cat needs a transformer to reach orbit?
